etymologies.heading: Etymology 1
paragraphs: From Middle English exempler, from Middle French exemplair, and its source, Latin exemplar, from Latin exemplum (“example”).
senses: Something fit to be imitated; an ideal, a worthy model or role model: a desirable example.

etymologies.heading: Etymology 2
paragraphs: From Middle English exempler, from Middle French exemplaire, and its source, Latin exemplāris. By surface analysis, example +‎ -ar. Doublet of exemplary.
